items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: he invited me, he asked me to join him with my fiddle... that was the beginning of Slim and Slam.

ctx.x: At that time he had had a sustaining program downtown at the radio station, which was WNEW. And this

fellow's name was Slim, Slim, Slim Gaileord, and at one of these jam sessions, he -- where we met, at Jock's place he approached me to join him on one of his programs, which he had a weekly, I think a weekly program on this radio station, playing his guitar by himself, you know, and singing.

And he invited me, he asked me to join him with my fiddle, and he said, man, why don't you come on down tomorrow with me and play with me on the program, which I did. And that was the beginning of Slim and Slam.
